subject: Sable Robotics — Org & API access: invite schedule & keys
body:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@sablerobotics.ai>, Priya Nair <priya.nair@sablerobotics.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Sable Robotics — Org & API access: invite schedule & keys

Hi Evan / Priya —

Great to have Sable moving into implementation. Quick note to align on the initial tenant and access plan so the CS <> implementation handoff is clean. Below is the minimal list we need to get your org created and your team invited: 

- Org name and preferred root email domain (for consoles/invites)
- List of initial users (name, email, role: Admin/Dev/Viewer) — CSV is easiest
- Which environments do you want now: test + prod (recommended)
- IP allowlist ranges (if any) and whether you require static egress
- Preferred date/time for first provisioning window (2-hour slot)

Karthik will act as the implementation lead for provisioning and will send the invite batch. Monica will coordinate the activation schedule and verify audit settings (SAML/MFA/KMS). We also have a short SOW attached that outlines the work and responsibilities.

Next steps: please reply with the CSV or list of users and confirm whether you want separate API keys for test and prod. If you need earlier telemetry access, we can provision a single test key now and rotate in prod after tenant boot.

Thanks —
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
(415) 555-0182

Attachment: Sable_Onboarding_SOW_v1.pdf (PDF)

IP allowlist: 52.23.12.0/24 (Sable prod egress), test can be open for initial setup
Preferred provisioning window: Wed Oct 14, 10:00–12:00 PT

Questions: 
1) Can you issue a temporary test API key for the first demo tomorrow?
2) What is the expected rotation process for keys and are there per-key scopes?

Thanks — Evan
Evan Brooks
Head of Platform
Sable Robotics

body_continued:
On Mon, Oct 12, 2026 at 12:05 PM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com> wrote:

> Hi Evan —
>
> Thanks for the details — we can absolutely do test + prod keys. Quick plan from infra side:
>
> 1) We'll create the org and two projects: sable-test and sable-prod. Each project gets a project-level API key and a service-account key for CI.
> 2) We'll invite the users as Admin/Dev/Viewer per your CSV. Admins will have console and key-create rights; Devs get key-create for test only unless promoted.
> 3) IP allowlist will be applied at project level for prod. If you need egress IPs, we'll provide the static NAT ranges we use in the reserved pool.
> 4) Key rotation: we recommend short-lived service-account keys for CI (30d) and long-lived project API keys rotated on a 90d cadence. We can enable automatic rotation hooks tied to your secret manager if desired.
>
> Action items for provisioning window (Wed Oct 14, 10:00 PT):
> - Evan / Priya: confirm the final CSV and provision the 2 users who will run first tests.
> - Naomi / Monica: confirm SAML enforcement and whether you want to enable MFA on first login.
> - Karthik: will create the projects and drop the initial test API key in the shared doc.
>
> I'll post the invite batch and the test key to the Drive link below during the window.
>
> Karthik
> Implementation Lead — Redwood Inference
> karthik_iyer@redwood.com
>
> Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-OnboardSharedDoc

Morning —

I'll run the activation checklist on Wed. Notes:
- Enable SAML + enforce MFA for Admins. We can set Viewer accounts to optional MFA for the first week if Sable prefers a low-friction pilot.
- Audit logs will be enabled with 30-day retention by default; if Sable wants longer retention we'll add an add-on.
- I'll use the invite template (attached) and send invites 30 minutes pre-window so users get the welcome flow.

Monica
Customer Implementation Manager
monica.patel@redwood.com
